Gurus and AI Chatbots Offer Spiritual Guidance Amidst Growing Demand

Spiritual leaders, referred to as gurus, are increasingly incorporating AI chatbots into their practices to provide guidance. This trend emerges as individuals are turning to artificial intelligence for answers and spiritual support. The integration of technology aims to meet a growing demand for accessible spiritual counsel.
